title: Think You're Missing Cash Back? Here's How to Get Help
summary: This Rho-Bank help article explains when and how to contact customer service for cash back discrepancies (e.g., bonus category earned at standard rate, missing rewards, lower-than-expected amounts, or suspected merchant miscategorization). It lists what to provide (transaction date, merchant, purchase amount, received vs expected cash back, receipts) and contact options: 1-800-RHO-BANK, in-app chat, or rhobank.com/help.
faqs: When should I contact Rho-Bank about missing or incorrect cash back?
